s1.syndrome_frame: Respiratory failure in a premature infant with severe lactic acidosis and bilateral airspace opacification
salient_findings: Severe lactic acidosis with venous blood pH 6.8 and lactate 22 mmol/L
Bilateral airspace opacification on chest X-ray
key_facts: Born at 27 weeks' gestation
Presented at 8 weeks of age (35 weeks corrected gestational age)
Required 3 days ventilation after birth due to neonatal respiratory distress syndrome
Fed with maternal expressed breast milk from day 3
Discharged from neonatal unit 10 days before presentation in good health with no respiratory support
No relevant exposures in household
Presented in respiratory failure with unrecordable blood pressure
Required ventilation with initial fraction of inspired oxygen (FiO2) of 1.00
Initial blood culture positive for Staphylococcus epidermidis
Subsequent blood cultures (day 3 and 5) negative
RT-PCR of nasopharyngeal swab positive
Other respiratory virus PCR negative
Echocardiogram showed normal cardiac function
